A DESIGN grill area exists on the existing portable core: DESIGN_PROFILE (grill + reasoning + decision directives) and a session-scope driver; a scripted design-grill session converges to a solid verdict on the same test doubles used for the goal area
Portability is proven with TWO real areas — the design grill runs and the goal suites stay green — and a fresh area is visibly cheap to add (the registry/hygiene touches are in place)
